# Nine to Fur

> Nine to Fur (@nine2fur) is a funny office comedy with no dialogue, for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Each video takes one real Indian IT office truth and plays it like old-school slapstick in colour. Tagline: "Funny office shorts." Made by Syed in Bengaluru, India, with AI tools and human direction.

Last updated: 2026-10-31

## What it is

- Funny office shorts built on real Indian IT office life: meetings, chai breaks, "one by two", standups, "you're on mute", the "quick call", the client's "small change by Friday", and the goodbye that never ends.
- Format: no dialogue. Big expressions, music and exaggerated sound effects, in the spirit of classic slapstick comedy, in colour.
- One 1:30 to 2:00 video per concept, then every gag is cut into its own Instagram Reel and YouTube Short.
- Look: one real person (Syed) with tactile felt and knit designer-toy coworkers.
- Status: new. The first video is coming soon, then new clips drop weekly.

## Cast

- Syed: the lead and a real person (also the creator). An earnest, polite new hire who tries a little too hard: the most polite person in the meeting and the most dramatic at the chai stall.
- Pip: the accelerant. An eager felt pigeon who makes everything escalate and has 40 ideas before lunch.
- Mo: the anchor. A deadpan felt capybara who never hurries and is somehow always already there.
- Ms. Hoot: the authority. A serene, kind felt owl boss who is always on a call; her slow head turn freezes the room.

## Coming up

- EP01, "The Meeting & The Chai Meeting" (coming soon). The same meeting happens twice: polite in the conference room, honest at the chai stall. Gags: Small change by Friday; The goodbye that never ends; The chai signal and the dash; One by two; The real meeting; The other chai meeting. Guest stars: Anna the chai-wala (a felt elephant) and a team of giraffe clients.
- Later: appraisal season, the "quick call", client visit day.

## Creator

- Syed, based in Bengaluru, India.
- Made with AI tools and human direction.

## FAQ

### What is Nine to Fur?
Nine to Fur is a funny office comedy with no dialogue. Each video takes one real Indian IT office moment, like the meeting, the chai break or "one by two", and plays it like old-school slapstick in colour: big expressions, music and exaggerated sound effects. Every video runs about two minutes and is cut into Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

### Who is in Nine to Fur?
Syed, the lead (an earnest, polite new hire), plus three felt coworkers: Pip (an eager pigeon who makes everything escalate), Mo (a deadpan capybara who is somehow always already there) and Ms. Hoot (a serene owl boss whose slow head turn freezes the room).

### Where can I watch Nine to Fur?
On YouTube Shorts at https://www.youtube.com/@nine2fur and on Instagram Reels at https://www.instagram.com/nine2fur/. The handle is @nine2fur everywhere.

### How often are new Nine to Fur clips posted?
Nine to Fur is new: the first video is coming soon, and new clips drop weekly after that.

### What is EP01 about?
EP01 is "The Meeting & The Chai Meeting", coming soon. The same meeting happens twice: polite in the conference room, honest at the chai stall. The guest stars are Anna the chai-wala, a felt elephant, and a team of giraffe clients.

### Does Nine to Fur have dialogue?
No. It has no spoken dialogue, only big expressions, music and exaggerated sound effects, so it works in any language and with the sound off.

### Is Nine to Fur made with AI?
Yes. Nine to Fur is made with AI tools and human direction from its creator, Syed.

### Who makes Nine to Fur?
Syed, a creator based in Bengaluru, India, who also plays the lead.
